front.title: OAuth Authorization Server Metadata Parameter for Requiring DPoP

abstract.t:
This specification defines a new OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata parameter, dpop_bound_access_tokens_required, which allows an authorization server to indicate that it always issues DPoP-bound access tokens and requires DPoP for all requests made to it to obtain access tokens, including pushed authorization requests.
This complements the metadata parameter of the same name defined in OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata.
